fieldValues.title: AI guidance
fieldValues.description: Structured instruction carried on a definition telling a language model what the definition captures and how to populate it: a required `purpose`, and optional `extraction`, `negativeGuidance`, and worked `examples`. It travels with the definition instead of living in an application's prompt, which is what makes a package usable by a tool that has never seen it before. Guidance belongs to the entity that owns the meaning: a Field's guidance is the Field's, and a Type's guidance supplies session framing only — it never redefines a Field's extraction semantics.
fieldValues.notes: Composition order is a recommended default, not an invariant: Type framing, View framing, Field extraction, negative guidance, examples.
